note: Sources and search queries for the gig-radar self-update. Rotate through venues and try 2-3 new discovery angles each run; log outcomes in gig-method-log.md.

keyVenues.name: Toulouse Lautrec Jazz Club
keyVenues.note: CURRENT premier London gypsy-jazz venue (La Bouche Manouche, London Django Collective). Regular manouche nights + annual London Gypsy Jazz Festival (Apr, out of the summer window). Ticketing subdomain sometimes 403s — read the main site.

keyVenues.name: Vortex Jazz Club — 'Gypsy Jazz Monthly'
keyVenues.note: Monthly manouche residency (Gina Boreham) since 2006, plus trad acts (Tuba Skinny played here). JS calendar — dates appear closer to the time.

keyVenues.name: Cecil Sharp House (EFDSS)
keyVenues.note: Cajun/zydeco dances, old-time jams, string-band nights, square dances.

keyVenues.name: SwingdanceUK special events
keyVenues.note: RICHEST confirmed source for live-band classic swing: free Regent's Park Sunday big bands (summer), 'Stompin' at the 100 Club', seasonal dances. Well-dated far ahead.

keyVenues.name: Nightjar
keyVenues.note: Nightly 21:00 hot jazz/swing/NO acts, cover on the door (no tickets). Only publishes ~2 weeks ahead — re-scrape every run for near-term dates.

keyVenues.name: The 100 Club
keyVenues.note: Trad-jazz strands + hosts SwingdanceUK's 'Stompin' at the 100 Club' nights. NB: old /listings/ URL now 404s — use /100club-events/.

keyVenues.name: Plaquemine Lock (Louisiana pub)
keyVenues.note: Free dining-pub gigs; roster stretched to ~4 weeks as of 2026-07-10. Residencies confirmed: Jack Jules & The Plaquemine Four (trad jazz, 1st & 3rd Sat + extra Fridays), Ten Bells Rag Band (last Fri), Dai Price Sat brunch, Al Dunn Sun brunch. Re-scrape fortnightly.

keyVenues.name: Fidelio Cafe
keyVenues.note: 'Fidelio Hot Club' roughly fortnightly Monday residency (feat. Sol Grimshaw). Best tracked via Sol Grimshaw's gig guide, which lists full dates.

keyVenues.name: The Hum
keyVenues.note: Emerging gypsy-jazz hub: free weekly Tuesday 'Midnight in Paris' manouche night + 'Gypsy Jazz Icons' concert series (Romane, Robin Nolan). Listings live on their Eventbrite organiser page.

keyVenues.name: Ram Jam Records at The Grey Horse
keyVenues.note: LOCAL — Kingston home turf. Occasional New Orleans bookings among mixed jazz/blues + a Sunday jazz jam. KEY TRICK: append ?format=json to the Squarespace events URL for the complete machine-readable calendar with timestamps (135 events retrieved 2026-07-10); works on any Squarespace site (also The Betsey Trotwood).

keyVenues.name: The Dukes of Highgate
keyVenues.note: London's dedicated honky-tonk bar: free Sunday sessions, country jam nights, US trad-country bookings. KEY TRICK: their WordPress tribe/events REST API is open — /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?per_page=50&start_date=YYYY-MM-DD returns every booked event with exact timestamps (proved nothing after 11 Sep 2026 as of 10 Jul). Poll it each run instead of the calendar widget.

keyVenues.name: Ron's Honky Tonk (promoter)
keyVenues.area: Bermondsey, London (Fabal Beerhall; formerly Water Rats)
keyVenues.note: Recurring multi-act honky-tonk nights. Watch for day/date mismatches on their listings (one 2026 entry failed weekday check).

keyVenues.name: Jamboree
keyVenues.note: TOP source as of 2026-07: weekly free swing afternoons (Wed TJ Johnson — no Aug dates posted yet, Sun Prospective Collective), weekly Thu Cable Street Rag Band swing dance, monthly 2nd-Sat Cajun Après-Midi, plus honky-tonk/jug one-offs (Dylan Earl 19 Aug). Paginate /upcoming-events/?pno=2..6; diary now runs ~8 weeks ahead — re-scrape every run.

keyVenues.name: Epsom Hot Jazz Club
keyVenues.note: LOCAL day-trip — Monday-afternoon hot-jazz club at St Joseph's Church Hall (doors 13:00, £15/£20); short direct train from Surbiton. Dated diary via The Jazz Guide (year unprinted — weekday-check).

keyVenues.name: Old Barn Hall trad jazz Sundays
keyVenues.note: Weekly Sunday-lunch trad club (13:00, £15 cash, dancing, light lunches) — very reachable from Surbiton. Dated diary via The Jazz Guide.

keyVenues.name: Spice of Life Monday jazz lunches
keyVenues.note: Monday 12:30 lunchtime trad/vintage sessions (Jake Leg Jug Band, Frisco Bay, Big Easy); dated diary via The Jazz Guide.

keyVenues.name: Ronnie Scott's
keyVenues.note: Mostly modern, but carries trad/swing strands (Tuba Skinny, TJ Johnson, Giacomo Smith, Nora Germain, Ray Gelato Christmas run). Plain fetch 403s — curl with a Chrome UA works; the full find-a-show listing (~20 pages) is crawlable and per-show JSON-LD carries dates (empty array = not on sale yet). TRAP (2026-07-19): show pages can exist before tickets go on sale, and the 'you may also like' sidebar dates look like the show's own date in scraped text — trust only the page's own JSON-LD startDate.

keyVenues.name: Green Note
keyVenues.note: Roots/americana/folk; cherry-pick trad-leaning acts + London Django Collective dates.

keyVenues.name: The Slaughtered Lamb
keyVenues.note: Americana/roots basement gigs; Come Down and Meet the Folks nights.

keyVenues.name: What's Cookin'
keyVenues.note: Long-running roots/americana club — strong trad-country/western-swing source. 2026-07-19: own website DOES carry current listings (Dom Glynn 22 Jul, Geraint Watkins 29 Jul) — no social scraping needed; Saturday slots sometimes 'TBC', re-check midweek.

keyVenues.name: The Fighting Cocks
keyVenues.note: LOCAL. Only roots/trad nights count here (ignore rock/punk/indie/metal), matching the calendar's Fighting Cocks rule.

keyVenues.name: The Bull's Head
keyVenues.note: LOCAL-ish. Historic jazz pub; trad/hot jazz acts.

keyVenues.name: Crazy Coqs (Live at Zedel)
keyVenues.note: Cabaret/vintage-jazz room; hot-jazz, Café Django, hot-harmonica swing. Event system occasionally errors — retry.

keyVenues.name: Boisdale (Belgravia & Canary Wharf)
keyVenues.note: Daily live jazz; Chrome-UA curl retrieves the full diary (~486 items) but it is overwhelmingly soul/funk/tribute — grep for jazz/swing tags. Listing page has no times/prices; use the /p/ event pages.

keyVenues.name: Cadogan Hall
keyVenues.note: Concert hall; seasonal big-band swing (Down for the Count 'Swing Into Christmas') PLUS the Jazz Repertory Company series page — swing-repertory concerts several times a year ('1956' 27 Sep, Ella & Louis 22 Nov, Goodman Carnegie recreation Jan 2027). NB series URL moved 2026-07: use cadoganhall.com/series/the-jazz-repertory-company-presents/ (the /whats-on/series/ path 404s). DFTC also booked 10 Oct + 29 Dec; skip their 'Voices of Soul' shows.

keyVenues.name: Wilton's Music Hall
keyVenues.note: Historic music hall booking vintage-swing acts (Tricity Vogue 11 Nov). What's-on grid is JS but per-event pages are server-rendered with the date in an EventpostDate span.

keyVenues.name: 46 Club
keyVenues.note: Standing weekly Thursday 20:00 New Orleans residency (New Orleans Jazz Bandits) — found via The Jazz Guide 2026-07-10. Far NW from Surbiton but reliable.

keyVenues.name: Vout-O-Reenees
keyVenues.note: Members' club with regular hot-jazz/manouche nights. KEY TRICK (2026-07-13): it's Wix Events — the full event list (ids/slugs/ISO dates) is embedded in the /events page HTML as warmupData JSON; plain curl + regex reads it. Bookings are ad hoc — re-scrape each run.

keyVenues.name: The Pheasantry (PizzaExpress Live)
keyVenues.note: NEW 2026-07-13: Chelsea supper-club room booking a steady vintage-swing strand (Swing Commanders western swing 4 Sep, Jive Aces 13 Sep, Blue Harlem 18 Sep). PizzaExpress's own site is JS/JWT-walled — harvest its diary via Halibuts instead.

keyVenues.name: Oriole Bar
keyVenues.note: TOP rolling-window source as of 2026-07-19: dedicated /oriole-music listings page covers ~3 months ahead with weekday cover prices (Tue £4 / Wed £6 / Thu £8 / Fri–Sat £12 + £6 late sets; sets 20:00 & 21:15). First direct scrape yielded 12 adds (Club Royale, Pipkin/Dunn piano nights, Boneshaker, Fezzes). Re-scrape every run.

keyVenues.name: Morocco Bound (Wandsworth & Bermondsey)
keyVenues.note: NEW 2026-07-19: bookshop-bar 'Jazz Manouche' series roughly fortnightly, alternating branches (£12, 19:00); Wandsworth branch is on the Surbiton side. Found via the DICE API — query the venue name on api.dice.fm unified_search each run.

keyVenues.name: Ongar Jazz Club
keyVenues.note: NEW 2026-07-19: Friday-night club booking manouche/swing (Djangoliers 9 Oct, Chris Dean's Swing Shift 18 Sep, Bronxville Babies 13 Nov). Far side — Central line to Epping + ~20 min bus/taxi. Dated diary via The Jazz Guide.

keyVenues.name: Colchester Jazz Club
keyVenues.note: NEW 2026-07-19: occasionally books touring trad bands (Sarah Spencer 26 Jul) — cheap Jazz Guide re-check; ~55 min from Liverpool Street.

closedOrDefunct.name: Le QuecumBar & Brasserie
closedOrDefunct.note: PERMANENTLY CLOSED since April 2022 after 19 years. Was 'the' London gypsy-jazz venue — do NOT re-add or chase for listings.

closedOrDefunct.name: Kansas Smitty's (Broadway Market bar)
closedOrDefunct.note: Bar closed; the house band now plays mainly private bookings/festivals, not a fixed public London residency. Watch for one-off/festival dates only.

aggregators.name: Songkick
aggregators.note: Artist/venue calendar pages work via plain fetch when you know the exact ID (Rob Heron 3743871, Boaters Inn 4052839); search is JS-walled and feeds curl decoy trending artists — WebSearch for the ID first.

aggregators.name: Bandsintown
aggregators.note: Effectively DEAD 2026-07-19: browse 403s even with Chrome UA and rest.bandsintown.com now returns an explicit auth-deny. Don't retry.

aggregators.name: DICE API (unified_search)
aggregators.note: CRACKED 2026-07-19: unauthenticated POST to api.dice.fm/unified_search with {"q":"<venue or artist>","lat":51.5074,"lng":-0.1278} returns dated events with venue and price (prices in pence: 2225 = £22.25). VENUE-NAME queries sweep whole programmes (Toulouse Lautrec, Morocco Bound, Piano Smithfield); genre keywords mostly return fallback/trending noise — filter by expected venue. The JS-only browse pages remain useless.

aggregators.name: FOAOTMAD session list
aggregators.note: NEW 2026-07-19: the old-time association's London/SE session map — Cock Tavern slow jam (explicit summer dates), Lucas Arms 1st/3rd Sun, Biddle Brothers 1st Wed, Prince of Wales Feathers (no anchor date). First old-time fixtures for the radar; re-check for date exceptions each run.

aggregators.name: Gypsy Jazz Agenda
aggregators.note: Community-maintained gypsy-jazz festival/gig calendar. 2026-07 check: festivals listed by month with no years — low value for dated London gigs.

aggregators.name: Sol Grimshaw gig guide
aggregators.note: STRONG find (2026-07): London gypsy-jazz guitarist's own guide lists full dates for Fidelio Hot Club, Crazy Coqs and other Hot Club-circuit shows. Artist gig guides beat broken venue calendars.

aggregators.name: Halibuts swing listings
aggregators.note: London swing-genre gig aggregator; surfaced Jamboree/Nightjar/Pheasantry swing nights. KEY TRICK (2026-07-13): pagination ?page=N steps week-by-week (date-filter GET params are ignored); event-detail pages carry full date/time. 2026-07-19: swing genre exhausted at ~page 17 (late Dec 2026); heavy noise from Sinatra The Musical and Boisdale crooner residencies tagged 'swing' — filter by venue/title. Dates still worth year-verification against the venue.

aggregators.name: Down for the Count — live dates
aggregators.note: UK's busiest vintage-swing orchestra; own tour page is well-dated (Cadogan Hall, Pizza Express Live shows).

aggregators.name: EFDSS Spektrix API
aggregators.note: Cecil Sharp House HTML 403s scrapers, but this public API returns the full event feed as JSON — the reliable way to check for cajun/old-time/square-dance programming. The /instances endpoint gives per-date times (used for Barndance Nov/Dec 2026).

aggregators.name: The Jazz Guide
aggregators.note: MAJOR find (2026-07): dated diaries for the suburban trad-jazz club circuit (Epsom Hot Jazz Club, Old Barn Hall Bookham, Pump House Watford, Amersham Jazz Club, Spice of Life lunches, Winning Post, 46 Club Uxbridge, Riverhead Sevenoaks). Year unprinted — weekday-check every date. Venue index paginates ?start=N (11 pages, ~85 venues); the national /gigs-and-events/ listing also paginates ?start=N (steps of 20, last page start=140) and is server-rendered. PARSING TRAP (2026-07-19): the national listing interleaves Premium Listing cards (h3.card__title) with plain rows (h4) — naive scraping pairs a row's title with a card's venue and fabricates phantom gigs; parse them separately. WebFetch summaries also invent weekdays on these pages — cross-check raw HTML. Winning Post venue page now 404s (its gigs still appear in the national listing). Diaries are rolling ~4–7 week windows — re-scrape monthly.

aggregators.name: Swing Patrol — Bishopsgate Swing Live
aggregators.note: Monthly LIVE-BAND swing dance at Bishopsgate Institute (Viellefon 18 Sep, Pete Horsfall 20 Nov) — distinct from the DJ-only 'Swing Den' first-Fridays (skip those). URL pattern /events/{slug}/DD-MM-YYYY/; WordPress redirects wrong-slug dates to whatever exists that day, so verify the final URL when probing.

aggregators.name: Swingland live-music events
aggregators.note: London swing-dance school's live-band socials page (A-Train at The Hammersmith Club with Rhythm Kitchen, 20 Jul) — well-dated with prices.

aggregators.name: UK Jazz News
aggregators.note: londonjazznews.com 301s here. WebFetch 403s but Chrome-UA curl works; article index is JS-loaded BUT the WordPress REST API works: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=... — useful for previews/leads rather than dated listings. Article pages 403 too, but /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?slug=<slug> returns the full article body via curl (2026-07-13: surfaced the Ewan Bleach Fleeting Paradise Jamboree residency).

aggregators.name: Jive Aces tour page
aggregators.note: UK's hardest-gigging jump-jive/swing band; own gig guide is fully dated (100 Club, Gatehouse, Beaverwood + South-East one-offs).

aggregators.name: Ags Connolly shows page
aggregators.note: Primary source for UK trad-country dates (403s WebFetch — use Chrome-UA curl); also surfaces Dave Sutherland bookings.

aggregators.name: Benoit Viellefon concerts page
aggregators.note: Artist gig guide (Bandsintown widget) for hot-club swing dates: Bishopsgate Swing Den, Green Note, South-coast day-trips.

aggregators.name: Eventbrite keyword-search pages
aggregators.note: PRODUCTIVE angle (2026-07-13): the /d/united-kingdom--london/<keyword>/ search pages read fine via plain fetch and event pages embed JSON-LD dates. Best keywords: gypsy jazz, trad jazz, honky tonk, swing dance live band, cajun ('zydeco'/'skiffle' return noise). Surfaced Charles Morris Jazzmen + cross-confirmed Jamboree one-offs. NB See Tickets and TicketSource are bot-blocked/JS-only — dead ends, don't retry.
